name: Example: Disable wiki on repositories
description: Wikis should be disabled on repositories where they are not actively used to reduce the attack surface.
remediation: Disable wiki in Repository Settings > General > Features > Wikis.

name: Example: Disable projects on repositories
description: Projects should be disabled on repositories where they are not actively used.
remediation: Disable projects in Repository Settings > General > Features > Projects.

name: Example: Require linear history
description: Linear commit history should be required to maintain a clean and auditable commit history.
remediation: Enable 'Require linear history' in branch protection settings.
